tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List Adbull's services (web development, SEO, GEO, ads, conversion, tracking) with a short description, the page URL, the starting price in DKK excl. VAT and the sub-services.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Get Adbull's indicative price packages in DKK excl. VAT, with what each package includes. Optionally for one service.

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Find Adbull's client cases with results. Optionally filter by a word in the title or summary, e.g. a client name, an industry or a service.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Adbull's Danish articles with sources about SEO, GEO, Google Ads, Meta ads, web development, CRO and tracking.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Company facts about Adbull ApS: address, CVR, contact details, opening hours, the team with roles and LinkedIn, and the B-mærket certification.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Get the links and details a person uses to contact Adbull: the contact form for a new website (free design sketch) or for SEO and ads (free review), phone and email. Nothing is sent by this tool.

tools.name: get_speed_test_link
tools.description: Get a link to Adbull's free website speed test (Google PageSpeed, mobile and desktop) that starts the test for a given website.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_services, get_contact_options · Private data: get_company_info, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_services, get_contact_options · Private data: get_company_info, get_contact_options · Public sink: get_contact_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
